verdicts.reason: A: the panel is centred and runs the full height with no margin. The text is stacked in an arbitrary staircase (headline, then the left copy below and to the left, then the right copy lower still on the right), the decorative cross lines are gone, and the side copy is tiny and hard to read. B: it keeps the original three-column layout and cross lines, but the panel is shoved to the left, leaving a big lopsided slab of wood on the right. The panel almost touches the top and bottom edges, and the side copy is small.
